result.topic_en: The page holds a single formula: a function y written as e^{2x} times a power series whose coefficients are the central binomial coefficients divided by factorials, with alternating signs. The rest of the page is blank apart from faint show-through from the other side of the leaf.

methods.what: Series expansion of y as e^{2x} times an alternating power series. The coefficients are the central binomial coefficients 1, 2, 6, 20, 70, 252 divided by n!.
